nodes.label: Iron Block Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style iron block texture. Uniform light grey metallic surface with subtle pixel grid pattern and slightly darker border lines forming a square tile. Color palette: light silver-grey (#C8C8C8), off-white highlights, medium grey mortar lines. Game purpose: crafted storage block for iron ingots, used as building material and for beacon bases; indicates high-value metal resource.
nodes.pattern: uniform grid with subtle seam lines
